name: supercritical_internal_nu
title: Near-supercritical internal convection: Nusselt-number correlations for vertical upward pipe flow (function library)
summary: Eighteen EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of turbulent vertical upward flow in a pipe at near-supercritical pressure: McAdams, Shitsman, Griem, Jackson, Gupta, Swenson, Xu, Mokry, Bringer-Smith, Ornatsky, Gorban, Zhu, Bishop, Yamagata, Kitoh, Krasnoshchekov-Protopopov, Petukhov and Krasnoshchekov. Most of them correct the Reynolds-analogy form with the wall-to-bulk density, viscosity, conductivity and heat-capacity ratios, or with a temperature-dependent exponent fixed by the position of the wall temperature relative to the pseudo-critical point. The heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/Di and is left to the caller.

authors: H. S. Swenson, J. R. Carver and C. R. Kakarala (Swenson correlation)
R. P. Bringer and J. M. Smith (Bringer-Smith correlation)
K. Kitoh, S. Koshizuka and Y. Oka (Kitoh correlation)
B. S. Petukhov, V. A. Kurganov and V. B. Ankudinov (Petukhov correlation)
E. A. Krasnoshchekov, V. S. Protopopov and I. V. Kuraeva (Krasnoshchekov and Krasnoshchekov-Protopopov correlations)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/conv_supercritical.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each correlation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block; all eighteen are quoted by ht together with the assessment of Chen, Fang, Xu and Su, Annals of Nuclear Energy 76 (2015) 451-460. Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).
